title: Over the Earth
caption: The whole ship from the starboard bow: the observatory dome, the science ring, the 204 m main wheel, the hydroponics drum, the tank farm and the drive.

title: Main wheel deck
caption: The 1 g wheel close up, with the name on its rim, window banks in the side wall and one of the two glazed reception pavilions beside an elevator spoke.

title: Under thrust
caption: From the stern quarter with the reactor at full power: the magnetic nozzle, the shadow shield and the four swept radiator fins glowing behind it.

title: Observatory and docks
caption: The glazed observatory dome with its shutters folded back, the docking node with a shuttle and two lifeboats, and the survey telescope on the hull.
